settings.text_help:
Wording shown to visitors lives in this extension's language files, so it
can be translated. Override it with FoF Linguist or a language pack.
settings.learnMoreLinkUrl_help: Leave blank to hide the link.
settings.layout_help: Controls the shape of the consent banner.
settings.equalWeightButtons_help: Recommended. Styling accept and decline identically avoids nudging visitors toward accepting.
settings.colors_help:
The banner follows your forum's theme, including dark mode. Set a colour
only to override it — leave blank to inherit.
settings.sweepUndeclared: Erase cookies no extension has declared
settings.sweepUndeclared_help:
When a visitor declines, also erase cookies that no extension declared
through the cookie consent extender. This catches trackers from
extensions that have not adopted it — but will also erase cookies an
extension genuinely needs, which may break it. Use the allow list below
to spare those.
settings.allowedCookies_help:
One name per line. Wrap in slashes for a pattern, e.g. /^app_/.
Cookies Flarum sets itself are always kept.

banner.description: Cookies are used on this site. You can manage your preferences or accept all cookies.

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.description: Cookies are small files this site stores in your browser. Below is what is stored and why. You can change your choice at any time.

cookies.flarum_session: Keeps you signed in while you browse.
cookies.flarum_remember: Signs you back in automatically on your next visit.
cookies.cc_cookie: Remembers your cookie choice so you are not asked again.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Required for the site to work — signing in, staying signed in, and remembering your cookie choice. These cannot be turned off.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand how the forum is used, so we can improve it. Nothing here is needed for the forum to work.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Used to measure advertising and to show you ads on other sites.
